title: Good price for what they are.
text: Good price for what they are.. They’re not the best, but considering you change them out often...not a bad price for two.

product_metadata.title: mDesign Plastic Transparent 72" x 72" Shower Curtain Liner - Water-Resistant, PEVA, 3-Gauge, No Odor, Inner Shower Curtain Liner for Bathroom, Shower, and Tub - 2 Pack - Clear
features: WATER-RESISTANT: No more slippery wet floors; This curtain is waterproof so that you can keep your bathroom floors free from splashes and sprays of water; Made to withstand damp, moisture-rich bathroom and shower environments; Protect your decorative shower curtains and keep them dry by using this liner; The PEVA coordinates with any decorative shower curtain; Generously sized; Set of 2

REINFORCED GROMMETS: 12 reinforced grommets make it easy to install with most types of shower curtain hooks or rings (not included); The reinforced top hem combined with the grommets ensure that the curtain will not be easily torn or pulled out of shape

WEIGHTED HEM: Encased magnets at the bottom keep the liner in place and reduce billowing; This shower curtain liner complements any bathroom color scheme at any home, apartment, condo, hotel, dorm, school shower, athletic club, RV, campers, and gym

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: Made of 100% PEVA with reinforced grommets for hanging; Encased magnets and weighted hems; Designed for use in moisture-rich bathroom environments; EASY CARE: Clean with a damp cloth; For best results, open fully after each use to air dry
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Each Measures 72" wide x 72" long
